verification.title: Verification
verification.readyBody: Both checks are approved and your photo is on file. You can go online and accept trips.
verification.oneMoreBody: Both checks are approved. Add a profile photo and you can go online. Riders use it to check they have the right vehicle.
verification.inProgressBody: Complete the steps below before you can go online.
verification.howGender: Gender verification: a person on the SheOut team checks the ID you upload below. It is never automatic.
verification.howPolice: Police verification: SheOut runs this check for you with the details on your ID. There is nothing for you to submit, and it updates here when it is done.
verification.yourIdBody: One government ID, used to confirm your identity. Aadhaar, passport, driving licence or voter ID. Make sure your name and photo are readable.
verification.yourRcBody: A photo of the registration certificate for the vehicle you drive. We check it against the registration number on your profile, so the number plate must be readable.
verification.chooseRcToContinue: Choose your RC photo to continue
verification.panBody: For tax on your payouts. Tax is deducted and reported against a PAN when we pay you, so adding it now keeps that from holding up money you have earned. It is not part of your verification, and you can add it later.
verification.fileHint: A clear photo (JPG, PNG or HEIC) or a PDF. Make sure the whole document is in the frame and readable.
verification.maskInvite: You can blur your ID number if you'd like, we only need your name, photo, and gender to verify you.

faq.q1: Why can I not go online?
faq.a1: Three things have to be in place: your ID and police verification both approved, and a profile photo on your account. Check Verification to see which checks are still pending, and My Profile to add a photo.
faq.q2: Why do I need a profile photo?
faq.a2: Riders see it when you are on your way. It is how a woman getting into a stranger's vehicle at night checks she has the right one. It is never shown to anyone before you accept a trip.
faq.q3: Why am I not getting requests?
faq.a3: You must be online, verified, and allowing location access. Requests are offered to the nearest available partners first, then further out. Requests also pause for up to ten minutes after a trip while the rider pays.
faq.q4: How do I contact my rider?
faq.a4: Through chat on the trip screen, from the moment you accept until the trip ends. Phone numbers are never shared in either direction and cannot be sent through chat. If something needs a call, call us.
faq.q5: What happens if I cancel a trip?
faq.a5: You will be asked why, in one tap. Cancelling often, relative to the trips you take on, is reviewed by a person here and never acted on automatically, so the reason you give is your side of it.
faq.q6: How are my earnings worked out?
faq.a6: Your earnings are your share of every trip your riders have paid for. Each paid fare is added to your SheOut wallet, and you can request a payout to your bank or UPI from Wallet & payouts.
